reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are rare for TikTok Shop, and $24.99 for one box is an easy impulse buy if a creator's video hits my sleep problem. I would try one box, not two.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? I also can't tell yet if bisglycinate alone does anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing the lab report and saying it helped their sleep or recovery; a clear reason why bisglycinate alone beats a mixed-form blend.
